segments.name: Electronics
segments.evidence: The Electronics segment provides products and services to customers, including digital instrument clusters, information displays, infotainment, cockpit domain controllers, CognitoAI TM , battery management systems, high voltage power electronics, and engineering services.

revenueModel.text: Car makers buy its cockpit electronics and displays.
revenueModel.evidence: As the Company has one reportable segment, net sales, total assets, depreciation, amortization and capital expenditures are equal to consolidated results.
